DocumentStyle.description:
Reviewed, bundled presentation choices. This is never a path or template source.
Plain remains the default for requests created before style selection existed.

importedDocument.description: Separate editable import candidate, never the saved draft.

documentJson.description: Bounded before decoding the edited resume.

MapImportReviewRequest.description: The editor may rearrange or add content; native session and revision remain authoritative.

accessibleText.description:
Bounded plain text from the exact retained source, used when an older
published revision is no longer present in the editor's current state.

ResumeDate.description:
One stable, ordered date or range. Either endpoint may be omitted. The label
can describe graduation, certification, or another optional date detail.

TrackerMetadata.description: Editable metadata, deliberately separate from immutable retained documents.
